title: Blessed Is the Man Who Fears the Lord

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, who greatly delights in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:1 (ESV): "...who greatly delights in his commandments!"

questions.question: His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:2 (ESV): "...the generation of the upright will be blessed."

questions.question: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures how long?
Light dawns in the darkness for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:4 (ESV): "Light dawns in the darkness for the upright;"

questions.question: He is gracious, merciful, and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:4 (ESV): "he is gracious, merciful, and righteous."

questions.question: It is well with the man who deals generously and lends; who conducts his affairs with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:5 (ESV): "...who conducts his affairs with justice."

questions.question: For the righteous will never be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:6 (ESV): "For the righteous will never be moved;"

questions.question: He will be remembered how long?
He is not afraid of bad news; his heart is firm, trusting in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:7 (ESV): "...his heart is firm, trusting in the Lord."

questions.question: His heart is steady; he will not be afraid, until he looks in triumph on his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:8 (ESV): "...until he looks in triumph on his adversaries."

questions.question: He has distributed freely; he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn is exalted in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:9 (ESV): "...his horn is exalted in honor."

questions.question: The wicked man sees it and is angry; he gnashes his teeth and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:10 (ESV): "...he gnashes his teeth and melts away;"

questions.question: The desire of the wicked will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:10 (ESV): "the desire of the wicked will perish!"

questions.question: Psalm 112 is a companion psalm to which other Psalm?
questions.explanation: They are both acrostic psalms with similar structure and themes.

questions.question: Who greatly delights in God's commandments?
options: The man who fears the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: The man who fears the Lord
questions.explanation: Psalm 112:1 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, who greatly delights in his commandments!"

key_verse_text: Praise the Lord! Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, who greatly delights in his commandments!
